title: Iron law of ML systems
caption: Execution time decomposes into data movement, computation, and fixed overhead. The two timed terms overlap between their maximum and their sum; every optimization in the book attacks exactly one of the three terms.

symbols.name: execution time
symbols.meaning: Total time for the workload or request.

symbols.name: achieved rate
symbols.meaning: Peak arithmetic rate times the hardware efficiency fraction actually realized.

symbols.name: overhead
symbols.meaning: Fixed latency that neither movement nor compute can hide.

title: Arithmetic intensity law
caption: Attainable compute is capped by the lower of peak rate and intensity times bandwidth. A workload left of the ridge cannot buy speed with more arithmetic — the roofline makes the ridge the machine's balance point.

symbols.name: bandwidth
symbols.meaning: Memory bandwidth of the target machine.

symbols.name: peak rate
symbols.meaning: Peak arithmetic throughput of the machine.

title: Llama 70B decode floor
caption: Batch-one Llama 2 70B decode on two H100s: every token reads all 140 GB of FP16 weights once, so the memory floor exceeds the compute floor by 295.2x. Batching, lower-precision weights, or speculative decode are the levers; faster arithmetic is not.

symbols.name: memory floor
symbols.meaning: Lower bound from moving all weights once per token.

symbols.name: compute floor
symbols.meaning: Lower bound from arithmetic at peak rate.

title: Fleet MTBF
caption: Independent failures multiply across a pool. A GPU at ~5.7 years MTTF looks reliable alone; a 1,024-accelerator cluster sees a failure about every two days. Fault tolerance is a requirement, not a feature.

symbols.name: component life
symbols.meaning: Mean time to failure of one accelerator.

title: Composed-request critical path
caption: A composed assistant's latency is set by its critical path, not by the sum of stages: parallel tool calls collapse to the slower one. The latency-budget principle must hold this sum at the chosen quantile.

symbols.name: parallel stages
symbols.meaning: Tool calls issued concurrently; only the slower bounds the path.

title: Amdahl ceiling
caption: The un-accelerated fraction caps total speedup. Making inference — 10% of the request path — ten times faster moves the system about 10%. The stage nobody owns sets the ceiling.

symbols.name: accelerated fraction
symbols.meaning: Share of execution time the speedup touches.

symbols.name: local speedup
symbols.meaning: Factor by which that fraction is accelerated.
